title: Updated report of COVID-19 vaccine safety monitoring in Japan: booster doses for Omicron variants and vaccinations for infants and young children.
ehr_evidence: The study uses spontaneous reporting data from healthcare professionals and marketing authorization holders (MAH).
summary: An update on COVID-19 vaccine safety monitoring in Japan, specifically regarding booster doses for Omicron variants in adults and vaccinations for infants and young children.
key_findings: Reporting rates of serious adverse events (myocarditis, pericarditis, anaphylaxis, and death) for bivalent vaccines were generally not higher than for any booster doses.
The reporting rate of serious adverse events was low in children aged 6 months to 4 years.
captured_features: Adverse event reports (myocarditis, pericarditis, anaphylaxis, death)
population: Infants and young children (6 months to 4 years) and adults (>=12 years) in Japan
limitations: Potential underestimation of the numbers and incidence rates of adverse events by using spontaneous reporting data.
